llm.summary: This is a Chinese K12 classroom-interaction coaching skill with disclosed, scoped use of classroom records and no evidence of hidden code or unsafe behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly designed for mainland China Chinese-language K12 use; deployment elsewhere needs localization of language, curriculum assumptions, and crisis-support contacts.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown and JSON schema/reference files only; no executable files, install scripts, dependency fetches, or remote payload behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions define clear boundaries, route adjacent tasks to other skills, prohibit naming students in interaction logs, and require teacher confirmation before records are stored.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It uses platform memory/workspace concepts and writes interactionLogs, but the behavior is disclosed, limited to classroom records, includes view/correct/delete/export/pause controls, and avoids individual student names in logs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's capabilities fit its stated purpose: it reads class profile, lesson plans, student tiers, and weakness summaries to suggest interaction, grouping, questioning, and cold-call alternatives, and it writes only post-class interaction logs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese-language K12 teacher classroom-interaction support. Before use, confirm the platform's classroom workspace permissions, teacher confirmation flow, and record deletion/export controls are active; do not deploy unchanged outside the mainland China K12 context without localizing curriculum, language, and crisis-referral information.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only language and locale assumptions are real, but platform-conventions.md explicitly states the library is for mainland China Chinese K12 settings, so this is a deployment-scope note rather than hidden language forcing.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger examples are broad classroom-interaction phrases, but they match the skill purpose and are balanced by non-trigger routing tables, privacy controls, and teacher-confirmed writeback.
[SDI-1] expected: The bundled ai-item-check.md is not used to turn this into an exam-authoring skill; SKILL.md invokes it only as a safety check for rare ad hoc simple examples and requires labeling before any repository use.
[SDI-4] expected: The apparent tension with 'does not produce questions' is narrowed by SKILL.md: formal question generation is delegated elsewhere, while incidental examples are constrained by self-check and human review.
